protocol.expansion: gold_standard/build_variants.py heuristic (gene +3, variant +5, disease keyword +1) with threshold > 4 and a required variant-string hit, applied to the pooled candidate lists of all ten recorded systems
protocol.caveats: Pooled judgments come from titles only, exactly like the frozen set, and every system contributes to the pool (so no single system is favoured); the rule is the project's own, not an external gold standard, and human adjudication (plan §2.3) remains necessary.
